question: Which city was the venue of all the three ODIs between the men's cricket teams of India and England held during March 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pune.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• England tour of India took place in March 2021.
 
• It was a major sporting event after the first wave of Covid-19 in India.
 
• This tour consisted of **4 Test matches**, **5 T20 matches,** and **3 ODI** matches.

 
 

 **FORMAT**
 **VENUE**
 **RESULT**
 
 

 Test matches (1st & 2nd)
 Chennai
 IND-ENG(3-1)
 
 

 Test matches (3rd & 4th)
 Ahmedabad
 
 

 T20 matches
 Ahmedabad
 IND-ENG(3-2)
 
 

 ODI matches
 Pune
 IND-ENG(2-1)
